remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Published in Chatham Episcopal Institute yearbook, *Mortar Board*, 1905, of which O'Keeffe was art editor. Copy consulted owned by Chatham Hall (formerly Chatham Episcopal Institute), Chatham, Virginia. Reproductions of signed illustrations; whereabouts of originals unknown. Published on page 41. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Reproduction of signed illustration. A woman, seen in profile in a high-collared dress, holds a piece of paper and reads from it. Text below the image reads, "I will now read the grades for the week." To the right of this illustration is another, this one featuring a woman seen straight on. The woman wears a dress and glasses. Text below the image reads, "You know how good I want you to be, good as gold."
dimensions: 6 1/8 x 8 or 8 x 6 1/8 inches, sheet, orientations vary
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
